# Your first dungeon in WoW Forever

What a dungeon is, the tank, healer and damage roles, the dungeons from level 13 to 30, how to get ready, how a pull works, what the first bosses do, loot manners and what to do when you wipe.

Updated Nov 5, 2026

Checked against build 1.60.1.70938

WoW Forever launched on 4 November 2026 at 23:00 UTC with a level cap of 60, and Blizzard's nine new five-player dungeons run from level 13 to 60. This guide covers your first dungeons, the ones from 13 to 30. They are the dungeons players ran in the beta, which stopped at 30 once the 1 October build raised its cap from 20. Four of them are new in Forever: The Hall of Thanes (13–18), Ruins of Lordaeron (15–20), Excavation Site: Wetlands (24–29) and City of Dalaran (28–33). Everything below is checked against the Forever client (build 1.60.1.70755, on 3 November 2026) and Blizzard's posts; anything that comes from Classic is marked.

## Dungeons from level 13 to 30

These are the dungeons up to level 30 that were open by the end of the beta: the ones in Blizzard's 1 October notes, and City of Dalaran, which opened on 8 October. The level is the one the client's dungeon list gives each dungeon (Blizzard's own levels are in brackets). Each name opens the dungeon's page, with its quests, bosses and entrance.

## Excavation Site Overview in World of Warcraft: Forever

The Explorer's League, a band of archeologists researching the origins of the Dwarven race, has long had a presence in the mountainous regions of the Wetlands with Whelgar's Excavation Site, a camp overrun with raptors, serving as its main hub. Strange activity was noted to the southeast of the site, and a new camp was set up to explore the newly uncovered titan activity.
The recommended level for Excavation Site is between 26 and 32. Even if you can pick up the quests at 24, entering the dungeon at that point is ill-advised, as the last boss is level 31.

## Location of Excavation Site in World of Warcraft: Forever

Excavation Site is located in Wetlands and is a new installment in WoW: Forever. In previous Classic iterations, this area was inaccessible. But with newly constructed roads, you can now find the entrance to the new dungeon at the top of the hill.
Entrance to Excavation Site
Meeting Stone and Entry
Alliance can easily access the dungeon from Menethil Harbor, which now has a boat connection with Stormwind through Auberdine, or you can run on foot through Loch Modan. Most players will have started their questing journey in the Wetlands at this point and will likely have a flight path in the zone already.
Horde will have a slightly longer trek, as they have to go through Hillsbrad Foothills and Arathi Highlands on foot to reach Wetlands. Make sure to pick up flight paths in Tarren Mill and Hammerfall during your walk to make your future experience slightly more pleasant.
As with many World of Warcraft: Forever Dungeons, wiping (the entire group dying) in Excavation Site can be a frustrating time due to the long run-back. Any player who has made the infamous run from Teldrassil to Ironforge will know this graveyard very well, as it's the only one in the zone. If your group fully wipes, you'll have to run across half the Wetlands map before reentering the dungeon.
Ideally, if the entire group is not dead, you should be able to get a rez (resurrection). This is a spell someone casts on you to bring your character back to life with a small amount of health and mana. Priests, Druids, and Shamans learn this early; Paladins need to complete a quest to learn resurrection and may not have it.
If you can't get a rez, click to release your spirit, then run back to the dungeon from the Spirit Healer (marked on the map below) as a ghost. You collect your body when you enter the instance.

## Overview

### What to expect

  * 9 bosses, in the client's order: Arcane Anomaly, Fel Ancient, Mana Devourer, Mana Elemental, Unstable Sentinel, Lyn the Ignored, Atrexis the Grave Knight, Mana Wraith and Shade of the Archmage. Client
  * Blizzard lists it for levels 28–33; the client's group finder suggests 28–35.
  * 14 drops seen by players in Forever. Seen in Forever
  * Worth it for: Graveweave Bindings (top pick for Affliction Warlock and 14 more specs at level 30), Ephemeral Grips (top pick for Affliction Warlock and 3 more specs at level 30), Manascale Treads (top pick for Arms Warrior and 3 more specs at level 30/40).
  * 7 quests, 7 confirmed in Forever.

### Blizzard says

> “This does not affect access to the City of Dalaran dungeon, but the Horde questline to obtain the Dalaran Sewer Key no longer grants unrestricted access to the city in the open world.”Blizzard Kaivax, WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 15, 2026-10-16

> “Now available for testing: the new City of Dalaran dungeon.”Blizzard Kaivax, WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 8, 2026-10-08

Blizzard Levels 28–33: Kaivax, “Krol’dok Stronghold” (2026-09-15).

### Getting there

  * Horde entrance: Silverpine Forest (69.6, 46.1) Client

The video's 69.3, 45.6 is 20 yards from the client's portal.

### How to get there

Horde entrance. Swim across Lordamere Lake from the Undercity side to the right-hand side of Dalaran, then follow the river around to the back of the city, past some friendly turtles, to the dungeon's meeting stone.

【turn11search6】 [wordlim: 200] Crawled: today; In WoW Forever, you’ll find books scattered around the world that can be picked up to turn in to your local library for some useful rewards. ... This book can be obtained from Whelgar’s Excavation Site in Wetlands (33.6, 47.9).
### Wetlands

There is one book located in the Wetlands.

#### Goaz Scrolls

This book can be obtained from Whelgar’s Excavation Site in Wetlands (33.6, 47.9). This is one of the more tedious books to get as Horde due to the distance you have to travel to get to Wetlands, but you can get it on the same trip as the book in Loch Modan.

To get to Wetlands, Horde will have to pass through Arathi Highlands from Hillsbrad Foothills, doing your best to avoid the level 30+ mobs you’ll come across, and then cross the bridge south to Wetlands. Wetlands is a contested zone, but it’s also an Alliance quest zone, so you can expect to encounter plenty of Alliance players here.

Once you’re in the zone, head to Whelgar’s Excavation Site, which is located in a little valley on the west side of the zone. On the western end of the site near one of the bridges you’ll see a piece of pottery half-buried in the ground with glittering Scrolls tucked inside. Click on the scrolls to loot the Goaz Scrolls.

Place lore · Changed in Forever

# Dalaran

The city of the Kirin Tor, still on the ground beside Lordamere Lake in the Alterac Mountains. In original World of Warcraft it sat under a violet dome nobody could enter. In Forever you can go in, and something has gone badly wrong inside.

Where
    Alterac Mountains, by Lordamere Lake

Rulers
    The Kirin Tor (an Alliance faction in the client)

Dungeon
    City of Dalaran, levels 28 to 33

New areas
    Old Dalaran Ruins, The Eventide, the Fel Grove
